notes: ACNS-X06_adjudication (Phase P05, venue acns; SoK: Evidence Boundaries of Attestation in Tool-Using AI Systems): delivered evaluation/venue2027/acns/rater_agreement.py implementing compute_agreement(ratings_matrix, num_bootstraps=1000, seed=2027) -> AgreementResult and measure(labels_a, labels_b) -> AgreementResult (Agreement alias). Computes Krippendorff's alpha for nominal data with arbitrary observers and missing labels; cross-checks Cohen's kappa if complete pairs across two raters are present; computes case/paper clustered percentile bootstrap confidence intervals with a deterministic seed. Pure standard library implementation (no external stats dependencies). All errors fail closed with stable reason codes (EMPTY_RATINGS_MATRIX, INSUFFICIENT_RATERS, NO_PAIRABLE_UNITS, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, MISMATCHED_LENGTHS, INVALID_RATINGS_MATRIX, INVALID_BOOTSTRAP_PARAMS). Tests in evaluation/venue2027/acns/test_rater_agreement.py (15 tests) cover positive controls (perfect agreement alpha=1.0 and kappa=1.0 across 2 and 4 raters; complete pairs matching known analytical Cohen kappa values 7/12 and 7/15; bootstrap CI bounds correct, enclosing point estimate, and seed-deterministic; measure convenience wrapper; JSON serializability) and adversarial controls (empty ratings matrices refused with EMPTY_RATINGS_MATRIX; insufficient raters refused with INSUFFICIENT_RATERS; unpairable matrices refused with NO_PAIRABLE_UNITS; all-disagreement handled without NaN crash for 2 and 3 raters; missing labels with None, empty strings, and NaN handled gracefully; invalid bootstrap and shape parameters fail closed). Full ACNS test suite regression passed (177 tests). ruff@0.7.1 check and format clean on touched paths. source_sha_after = base commit SHA per repo convention.
